    AI Overview
    Yes, social media influencer Kate Hudson's 2-year-old daughter, Eliza Adalynn, passed away in June 2021 after a long battle with a rare childhood cancer, a heartbreaking journey shared with millions on TikTok via the account "@HeyEliza". Eliza was diagnosed with a rhabdoid tumor when she was 10 months old, and her parents chronicled her fight, sharing moments of joy and immense pain, until her passing on Father's Day 2021.
